quote.text: Not everything that can be counted counts, and not everything that counts can be counted.
quote.author: William Bruce Cameron, Informal Sociology (1963) — routinely misattributed to Einstein, which rather proves the point

stories.headline: The burr you are sold is the diameter. The burr that decides is the alignment
stories.dek: Ninety-eight millimetres is the number on the label; two hundredths of a millimetre is the number in the cup. Four champions blind-tasted twenty-four grinders and did not rank them by price.

stories.headline: Gold fell three-tenths of a per cent during a shooting war. That is the whole regime in one print
stories.dek: Three central banks raised rates in nine days into an oil shock none of them caused. The ten-year reached levels last seen in 2007, the dollar took a fourth straight session — and the haven trade lost to the real yield.

stories.headline: Twenty-four dollars
stories.dek: Nepal wrote the cooperative into its constitution as a pillar of the national economy. Seven point four million people put four hundred and seventy-eight billion rupees inside it. When the state finally began refunding the victims, the first day paid three hundred and seventy-eight people an average of twenty-four US dollars each.

stories.headline: Twenty-one guns, a state dinner, and no communiqué
stories.dek: The first Chinese state visit to Washington in eleven years produced a sixty-day extension, two pandas and a hundred thousand student places. The White House posted no joint statement, no fact sheet and no agreement — and that absence is the document.

stories.headline: SP Group said the fourth quarter “may decrease.” The oil window it was priced in says otherwise
stories.dek: Core inflation reached 2.2 per cent in August on a tariff that rose seventeen. The announcement setting the next one lands Monday — and the window behind it rose.

stories.headline: Alibaba announced a full Chinese AI stack. The chip at the centre of it ships in 2027
stories.dek: Silicon, models, interconnect and twenty gigawatts of data centre by 2032 — declared in three days. The dates underneath are the part worth reading: nothing unveiled this week is in a rack this year.

stories.kicker: The home lab · the week a benchmark got audited
stories.headline: Ninety-eight per cent of the scores, at six gigabytes — and a token that differs one time in five
stories.dek: Prism’s ternary 27B is the most downloaded text model on HuggingFace this week. A reader went at its own numbers, the vendor corrected its table the same day, and stock llama.cpp still cannot load the file.

stories.kicker: Gear · the headline spec and the governing one
stories.headline: Five thousand pixels an eye, and a seventy-degree hole to look through
stories.dek: Meta’s VR Glasses weigh a hundred grams and cost thirteen hundred dollars. Every reviewer led with the resolution, then a paragraph later with a field of view two-thirds of a Quest 3’s.

stories.kicker: Objects · the order book shuts on 5 October
stories.headline: A watch called Off-Grid, which you charge with a cable
stories.dek: H. Moser has built a quartz digital watch, priced it at a tenth of its usual entry, and opened a twelve-day ordering window. The irony was the first thing every reviewer reached for, and the second thing they conceded was beside the point.

stories.kicker: Culture · ninth place, ninety-three per cent
stories.headline: A two-hander about a prisoner and his warden opened on fifteen hundred screens and beat almost everything on merit
stories.dek: Padraic McKinley’s debut took two point three million dollars and the best notices of the week. Meanwhile a London jazz band went to number one in Britain — and the sharpest review of the record says they are standing still.

stories.kicker: The tween years · a study published Tuesday
stories.headline: The pathway from exam pressure to problem phone use runs through restriction, not through the phone
stories.dek: Three hundred and eleven eleven-to-fourteen-year-olds, modelled two ways. Academic stress predicted compulsive social-media use — but almost entirely by way of restrictive parenting, and supportive parenting did not carry the effect at all.

stories.kicker: Down the rabbit hole · lapidary & gem cutting
stories.headline: You will destroy most of what you buy
stories.dek: Forty grammes of sapphire rough becomes eleven carats of finished stone. That is not a mistake; it is the sport. And the price of entry has fallen from four thousand dollars to about five hundred and thirty in roughly three years.

stories.kicker: The long game · a hundred and forty-seven thousand wrists
stories.headline: Twelve minutes a week of hard effort matched a hundred and fifty minutes of moderate
stories.dek: The largest pooled accelerometer study yet published puts a startling number on intensity. It also rests on a single week of wear, years before the outcome it predicts — and a paper this year says that biases exactly this kind of finding.

stories.kicker: The agenda · one thing shuts in six days
stories.headline: Book now, plan ahead
stories.dek: Marathon entries close on the 30th and the Grand Prix’s cheap seats are the only ones left. Every row below was re-verified this morning at the promoter, the venue or the official box office.
